caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile design with a blue background and off-white or cream-colored patterns. The main section of the textile contains a symmetrical arrangement of floral and geometric motifs, including star shapes and heart-like petals organized in a grid pattern. Along the bottom edge are three stylized trees with round canopies, standing behind a pattern that resembles a fence. To the left of the trees is a depiction of a lion, above which the name "MARY WEBB" and the year "1839" are inscribed in block letters. The left margin of the textile includes three more stylized trees stacked vertically, separated by horizontal bars. The right and top edges are bordered by additional rows of geometric motifs. Along the right and top sides, vertically oriented text reads "JEFFERSON CO. VA" and "HERBERTZON CO." respectively. The composition uses only two colors, blue and off-white, and is constructed with a highly regular, woven appearance.
title: Tyler Coverlet
